svg.title: Electronics engineer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as electronics engineer, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A simple circuit loop connects a zigzag resistor and two clearly separated capacitor plates. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face and round glasses.
